batchSettings.limitsDescription: Your current subscription allows batch uploads with the following limits
batchSettings.upgradeHint: 💡 Upgrade to Pro or Max plan for larger batch uploads and more concurrent processing
batchSettings.maxConcurrentTooltip: Controls how many receipts can be processed simultaneously. Higher values may speed up batch uploads but could use more system resources.
batchSettings.maxConcurrentDescription: Processing multiple receipts at once can speed up batch uploads but may use more resources.
batchSettings.timeoutTooltip: Maximum time to wait for each receipt to process before timing out. Longer timeouts allow for more complex receipts but may slow down batch processing.
batchSettings.timeoutDescription: Timeout range: 30 seconds (fast) to 5 minutes (thorough processing)
batchSettings.retriesTooltip: Number of times to retry processing a failed receipt before marking it as failed. More retries increase success rate but may slow down batch processing.
batchSettings.autoStartTooltip: When enabled, receipt processing will start automatically as soon as files are added to the queue.
batchSettings.autoStartDescription: Automatically start processing when files are added
batchSettings.preserveQualityTooltip: When enabled, images will be uploaded without compression to preserve maximum quality for reports and analysis. This may result in larger file sizes and longer upload times.
batchSettings.preserveQualityDescription: Skip image compression during batch uploads for maximum quality
